title: Add packages — pixi_add
text: Add packages pixi manifest install . pixi adds can solved together rest project's dependencies. R package names translated conda names: "dplyr" becomes r-dplyr "Rcpp" becomes r-rcpp (conda names lowercase). Use prefix say package comes : "bioc::DESeq2": Bioconductor package (bioconductor-deseq2 bioconda channel, added project needed). "conda::gdal": conda package R package, used . Names containing - _, "c-compiler", also used . "cran::dplyr": "dplyr". information, see https://pixi.sh/latest/reference/cli/pixi/add/.

title: Setup pixi environment safely — setup_pixi
text: setup_pixi() provides complete pixi setup R projects. checks pixi availability, initializes pixi project needed, configures R use pixi-managed packages. function prioritizes safety uses .libPaths() instead environment variables avoid shared library conflicts.

title: Setup pixi environment safely — setup_pixi
code: setup_pixi(add_to_rprofile = TRUE, global = FALSE, init_if_missing = TRUE)

title: Setup pixi environment safely — setup_pixi
text: add_to_rprofile Logical. TRUE, adds pixi library configuration .Rprofile persistence across sessions. Default FALSE. global Logical. TRUE add_to_rprofile = TRUE, adds global ~/.Rprofile instead project-local .Rprofile. Default FALSE. init_if_missing Logical. TRUE, runs pixi init pixi.toml found. Default TRUE.

title: Setup pixi environment safely — setup_pixi
text: Invisibly returns list status setup step.

title: Setup pixi environment safely — setup_pixi
text: function performs following steps: Checks pixi available PATH (adds found) Checks pixi.toml project root (runs pixi init found) Configures R use pixi library primary package source Optionally adds configuration .Rprofile persistence Instead setting environment variables (can cause shared library conflicts), function modifies .libPaths() prioritize pixi library.

title: Setup pixi environment safely — setup_pixi
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Basic setup - just configure for current session setup_pixi()  # Full setup - add to .Rprofile for persistence setup_pixi(add_to_rprofile = TRUE)  # Setup without auto-initializing pixi project setup_pixi(init_if_missing = FALSE) } # }

title: rpix (development version)
text: add() now pixi_add(). add() still works now, deprecation warning. remove() search() now pixi_remove() pixi_search(). old names removed rather deprecated, masked base::remove() base::search() whenever rpix attached. pixi_to_path() longer exported. rpix finds pixi .

title: rpix (development version)
text: pixi commands now go single internal runner built processx (#19). Arguments passed without shell quoting, commands work subfolder project (--manifest-path), pixi failures become R errors, pixi found even isn’t PATH (set options(rpix.pixi_path = ...) unusual installs). pixi_add(), pixi_remove() pixi_search() dry_run = TRUE now return command invisibly. R package names now translated conda names properly (#21): names lowercased ("Rcpp" becomes r-rcpp), pak-like prefix says package comes : "bioc::DESeq2" Bioconductor packages bioconda (#17), "conda::gdal" conda packages aren’t R packages. Names - _ used . pixi_add() accepts version constraints inline ("dplyr>=1.1") one constraint per package versions. pixi_add(channel = ) works : pixi --channel flag pixi add, channel now added project used package spec. happens automatically bioconda. pixi_add() suggests bioc:: conda:: package can’t found. Added tests.
